title: Functorial flat resolutions with independent site and coefficient universes
statement:
Let (C,J) be a site essentially small in universe r, and R a sheaf of commutative rings in universe r. The category of module sheaves in universe r has functorial flat resolutions, for the sheafified tensor monoidal structure. No equality between the site and coefficient universes is assumed.
Definitions and coefficient conventions: [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

proof.text: The free presheaf on the underlying presheaf of sections maps epimorphically to every module presheaf. Sheafification gives a functorial epimorphic cover of every module sheaf by sheafified free presheaves. The explicit tensor/sheafification comparison and objectwise flatness show these covers are flat. The reduced kernel construction gives a left resolution.
